searchText: The Verkle tree EIP has a gas cost scheme that still charges a fixed cost per branch and per chunk, so it doesn't require literal byte by byte awareness But it definitely is much easier to actually implement the scheme The fact that we are going down to a single layer tree really helped a lot in making that simpler The problem with making gas metering more closely based on witness properties today is that there are so many special cases And yes, sibling nodes having variable sizes is definitely one of those special cases
